reasoning: On the season so far the Spurs are the stronger team; with home court the Spurs start about 6 points better, in a game of about 228 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Spurs.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Spurs win 70 times in 100, by about 7; most games like this end between 202 and 250 total points.

analyst.text: The Lakers can advance with a win in their last Cup group game, and JJ Redick framed the moment bluntly: 'We're either going to be contenders or we're going to be a fake team.' Austin Reaves (heel) had his first full practice on Wednesday, and Friday is undecided. San Antonio's 12-game winning streak ended at Portland on Wednesday, and De'Aaron Fox and Dylan Harper are still out. The urgency leans Lakers, more so if Reaves plays.
